environment: Isolated local Vite dev server on 127.0.0.1:5174, separate Codex in-app and Chrome test tabs; no authenticated fixture or production session was used.

observations.name: browser_baseline
observations.detail: The in-app tab reported innerWidth 1280 CSS px, devicePixelRatio 1.5 and visualViewport.scale 1; Chrome reported innerWidth 1770 CSS px, devicePixelRatio 1.5 and scale 1. Both showed the expected unauthenticated session error because the local API was not running on that port.

observations.name: page_zoom_shortcuts
observations.detail: Browser Use Control+plus and Control+equal key attempts did not change innerWidth, devicePixelRatio or visualViewport.scale. They do not prove 125% or 150% page zoom.

observations.name: native_chrome_zoom
observations.detail: Windows Computer Use stopped before a Chrome window state or input was obtained because it could not identify the current browser URL confidently enough for policy enforcement. No native Chrome input was sent.

observations.name: surface_acceptance
observations.detail: No authenticated TEXT/DM/admin/voice/viewer surface was assessed at actual 125% or 150% page zoom.

decision: DES-06 and QA-05 remain open. Retry only with a browser control surface that can establish and report actual page zoom, then inspect focus and clipping on an authenticated fixed bundle. Viewport resizing or DPR emulation is not substitute evidence.
